plan.name: Show checked reader charts in modeled proposals
plan.summary: Deliver this whole step in one plumbing pull request: modeled drafting writes a pure view.json beside the model, and both the check tool and the independent final check use an immutable snapshot at the proposal's bounds, deriving charts through the existing complete TLC graph, invariant replay and reader evaluator through 500 states and preserving actionable view and hiding refusals; above 500 states, passing model checks instead save a successful too_large limitation with the reachable count, capacity and tool/configuration provenance, requiring a well-formed view without evaluating it against the graph. Save the exact view, sibling TLA+ includes and a versioned computed chart or limitation with a separate fingerprint binding the full model, includes, view, bounds, statements, pinned tools and artifact contents through formalization records, proposal markers, recovered runs, previous drafts, amendments and the project written at ratification; reject missing or stale evidence for new publication while preserving older stored proposals, statement hashes, locks and proof claims. Generate literal-safe Mermaid stateDiagram-v2 for supported new modeled proposals, revisions and amendments, with initial states, per-state unavailable actions, verbatim rule wording, hidden steps, separately defined TLC and chart counts and checked bounds; above capacity publish a short note instead, explaining that TLC reached the recorded number of states at those bounds, more than the 500 charts are drawn for, while retaining statement tables, existing checks and ratification instructions, explicitly refusing oversized comments rather than truncating usable proposals, and keeping plumbing and plans of issues chart-free. Keep the drafting guidance "thousands of states, not millions" and explain that charts are drawn for models of up to 500 states without asking models to shrink; extend the existing drafting and factory fakes for required views and checked evidence, preserve their assertions and TLC command contracts, exercise repair, independent final computation, invalidation, persistence, recovery, ratification, literal rendering and above-capacity publication offline, and extend the existing formalize integration test to check the chart using pinned TLC. Update SPEC.md with this delivered behavior and supporting D-0016, D-0034, D-0045, D-0049, D-0105, D-0122, D-0294, D-0335 and D-0343 citations, the README's short linked description within 400 lines, docs/statecharts.md and docs/factory.md; the merger records the new proposal-view, artifact-binding and publication policy, including the nonblocking size limitation, because this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestReader603CheckFeedbackAndRepair
tests.says: Missing, invalid and dishonest views get actionable feedback; a repaired view produces a chart from the staged model, includes, exact bounds and TLC rule evidence without changing statement hashes.

tests.name: TestReader603Capacity
tests.says: A complete 500-state graph produces a chart; 501 states pass with a bound too_large limitation containing the reachable count, capacity and provenance but no chart, and still require a well-formed view without evaluating its mappings or hiding.

tests.name: TestReader603IndependentFinalCheck
tests.says: After an agent checks and edits a draft, the independent final check recomputes from the final files, ignores agent-supplied derived artifacts and refuses a final invalid view.

tests.name: TestReader603PersistenceAndStaging
tests.says: Exact view and include bytes and the computed snapshot survive formalization JSON, previous-draft and amendment staging, and project writing, with unchanged lock and legacy proposal semantics.

tests.name: TestReader603ChangedInputsInvalidate
tests.says: Changing the model, include set or bytes, view, bounds, rule wording, tool provenance or chart invalidates a saved snapshot; fresh checks bind each changed input independently of the statement hash.

tests.name: TestReader603RegularInputsAndPrompt
tests.says: The modeled prompt teaches the pure view contract, keeps thousands-of-states bounds guidance and explains the 500-state chart capacity without requiring smaller models; view and include reads refuse links without exposing contents.

tests.name: TestReader603PostsRevisionAndRatification
tests.says: New proposals and revisions publish the computed Mermaid and accompanying evidence, preserve it in markers, and write the same view and snapshot at ratification.

tests.name: TestReader603AmendmentAndCurrent
tests.says: An amendment reads the current project's saved view and includes, publishes its checked chart beside the existing change table, and preserves the amended lock semantics.

tests.name: TestReader603RecoveryAndRefusal
tests.says: A recovered completed run publishes the saved checked chart without another agent run; missing or stale reader evidence blocks usable publication on both fresh and recovered drafts.

tests.name: TestReader603LiteralRenderingAndKinds
tests.says: Labels and exact rule wording remain literal in generated Mermaid and tables, all displayed arrows come from computed evidence, legacy records stay readable, and plumbing and plans of issues have no chart.

tests.name: TestReader603CommentCapacity
tests.says: A modeled chart that cannot fit the comment is explicitly refused before publication rather than silently clipped while offering ratification.

tests.name: TestReader603CheckToolRepair
tests.says: The real check tool reports repairable view failures and then the computed chart counts and bounds after repair, recording failed and passing checks accurately.

tests.name: TestReader603LargePersistenceAndFinalCheck
tests.says: A final check replaces agent-supplied or stale charts with a fresh size limitation at the final bounds, and that limitation survives formalization JSON, previous and amendment staging and project writing without changing lock identity.

tests.name: TestReader603LargeChangedInputsInvalidate
tests.says: Size limitations bind the same source, include, view, bounds, statement and tool inputs as charts; changed inputs or limitation contents refuse reuse, while fresh checks deterministically bind the new inputs.

tests.name: TestReader603LargePublicationAndRecovery
tests.says: Above-capacity proposals, revisions and amendments publish an explicit size note with bounds and preserve the bound limitation through markers, recovered runs, current projects and ratification; missing or stale evidence refuses publication.

tests.name: TestReader603CheckToolCapacity
tests.says: The check tool treats the above-capacity limitation as a passing check, reports its code, counts and bounds, and continues refusing malformed views at the same size.
